meta.name: langchain4j-spring-boot-integration
meta.description: Provides integration patterns for LangChain4j with Spring Boot. Configures AI model beans, sets up chat memory with Spring context, integrates RAG pipelines with Spring Data, and handles auto-configuration, dependency injection, and Spring ecosystem integration. Use when embedding LangChain4j into Spring Boot applications, building Java LLM applications with @Bean configuration, or setting up Spring AI patterns.
